scope: distance reader and positive-width default branch decoded - the ps codec is now fully mapped

distance_0x670CB0.if_bits_eq_1: unary: read bits until a 1, return the count
distance_0x670CB0.otherwise: read 1 bit -> 1 means distance 1; else read `bits` bits; if that value != (1<<bits)-1 return it; else continue with a longer form
distance_0x670CB0.note: an Elias-gamma style delta index coder

default_branch_0x670B15.reached: when field->codec matches none of the 46 negative constants (i.e. a positive fixed width)
default_branch_0x670B15.0x670B17: call 0x447190 - 1 bit: 0 means the value is zero
default_branch_0x670B15.0x670B37: else call 0x66FE30(field->codec) -> read `codec` bits and convert, store to *dst

complete_ps_stream_layout: bit: mode (0 = 5-bit last follows, 1 = last = bit+1)
per field: 1 bit 'present'; if 0 -> delta decoder(0x670FF0)
delta decoder: 1 bit continuation; 5 bits new index; distance (0x670CB0); per-field codec (0x6701D0) for each index in the gap
codec positive N: 1 bit zero-flag + N bits value; codec -57: 1 bit bool; -58/-100: float forms
